iansilber.en: Designers must partner with the model, treating it as the core product; design tokens and conversation over pixels, with rapid prototyping using live models.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型紧密合作，将模型视为核心产品；设计应侧重令牌与对话而非像素，并用实时模型快速原型设计。

iansilber.en: AI is already a great product designer, but humans are essential for user needs and point of view; design process is messy but AI amplifies creativity.
iansilber.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但人类对用户需求和观点至关重要；设计过程虽混乱，但 AI 能放大创造力。

iansilber.en: Starting today gives designers a leg up; traditional design process is obsolete, speed is key; embrace building in public and rapid iteration.
iansilber.zh: 从今天开始让设计师占得先机；传统设计流程已过时，速度是关键；拥抱公开构建和快速迭代。

iansilber.en: Design roles will blur with PM and engineering, but specialized roles remain valuable; future may see more designers than engineers.
iansilber.zh: 设计角色将与产品和工程融合，但专业化角色仍有价值；未来设计师可能多于工程师。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调火箭完全快速复用是航天圣杯，可将每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍。

elon.en: AI safety hinges on rigorous truth-seeking; programming AI to lie is the biggest risk.
elon.zh: 从 2023 年起，马斯克持续强调 AI 安全在于追求真理，编程让 AI 撒谎是最大风险。

elon.en: Civilization's greatest threat is population collapse; AI and robotics can solve abundance.
elon.zh: 2024 年后，马斯克认为文明最大威胁是人口崩溃，AI 和机器人可带来富足。

elon.en: AI will surpass all human intelligence by 2030; multiple deep intelligences will coexist.
elon.zh: 2025 年起，马斯克预测 AI 将在 2030 年前超越所有人类智能，且多个深度智能共存。

elon.en: Space-based AI data centers will be the cheapest scalable option within 36 months.
elon.zh: 2026 年，马斯克提出太空 AI 数据中心将在 36 个月内成为最廉价可扩展方案。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient; diverse data and pre-training plus fine-tuning are key for generalist robot models.
finn.zh: 2025 年：规模是必要但不充分；多样化数据与预训练加微调是通用机器人模型的关键。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models aids robot following of open-ended prompts; RL in post-training boosts success and speed.
finn.zh: 2025 年：语言模型生成的合成数据帮助机器人遵循开放式指令；后训练中的强化学习提升成功率与速度。

finn.en: Physical AI demands far fewer mistakes; long-term autonomy via scalable RL with human interventions and general value function.
finn.zh: 2026 年：物理 AI 要求更少错误；通过带人工干预和通用价值函数的可扩展强化学习实现长期自主。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; diverse data and detailed prompting enable compositional generalization.
finn.zh: 2026 年：单一通用模型可媲美或超越微调专家；多样化数据与详细提示实现组合泛化。

finn.en: Robot experience data is irreplaceable; watching humans is insufficient; embodied data costs limit open-source democratization.
finn.zh: 2026 年：机器人经验数据不可替代；观看人类不够；具身数据成本限制开源民主化。

linqiao.en: AGI as a single model is wrong; specialized intelligence per company will dominate, with millions of specialized models.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AGI 作为单一模型是错误的，每家公司将拥有自己的专用智能，未来会有数百万个专用模型。

linqiao.en: Open models will handle 90% of enterprise workflows; frontier model companies may be overvalued.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他提出开放模型将处理 90%的企业工作流，前沿模型公司可能被高估。

linqiao.en: Post-training is key for durable AI businesses; progression from prompting to RL mirrors human learning.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他强调后训练是构建持久 AI 业务的关键，从提示到强化学习的演进类似人类学习。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit no longer guarantees durability; post-training builds moat and cuts costs 5-10x.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他认为产品市场契合不再保证持久性，后训练能构建护城河并降低 5-10 倍成本。

linqiao.en: Application cloning is easy; baking data into model is stronger moat than app itself.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他指出应用克隆容易，将数据融入模型比应用本身更能构建护城河。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier, reducing capital needs; VC should focus on early-stage and pro rata returns.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年初，Gary 认为 AI 降低了创业门槛，资本不再是关键；风投应聚焦早期投资和按比例回报。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest VC wave; open-source models counterbalance frontier labs; small autonomous teams with agents win.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他强调 AI 是风投史上最大浪潮，开源模型制衡前沿实验室，小团队用智能体取胜。

garrytan.en: AI progresses slower than researchers think; open-source AI prevents unipolar superintelligence; personal agents emerge.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他提出 AI 进展比想象慢，开源防止单极超级智能，个人智能体开始兴起。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI: agents on your infrastructure, skill files as code, compounding daily; markdown is code.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他提出个人 AGI 概念：智能体运行在自己的基础设施上，技能文件即代码，日积月累。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding multiplies output; SaaS per-seat models may vanish; agents replace mid-level management.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他认为智能体式编程大幅提升产出，SaaS 按席位模式可能消失，智能体取代中层管理。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, guides long-term vision; industrial AI automates industries one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 将物理世界数字化、把原子当作比特处理，是长期愿景的框架；工业 AI 逐个行业实现自动化（2026 年 7 月）。

traviskalanick.en: Stealth mode is a cultural advantage, allowing focus on internal correctness over external validation; resistance to change is the final boss.
traviskalanick.zh: 隐身模式是一种文化优势，让人专注于内部正确性而非外部认可；对变革的抵制是终极挑战（2026 年 7 月）。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI is the next industrial revolution, automating food, mining, transport; entrepreneurs must fight for the best idea and be resilient.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业 AI 是下一次工业革命，自动化食品、采矿、运输；创业者必须为最佳想法而战并保持韧性（2026 年 8 月）。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner and more effective; complacency leads to failure.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为动力是不纯粹的；爱上新使命更干净有效；自满导致失败（2026 年 8 月）。

traviskalanick.en: Media landscape changed, founders can communicate directly; Elon Musk buying Twitter was a turning point for free speech.
traviskalanick.zh: 媒体格局已变，创始人可直接沟通；马斯克收购推特是言论自由的转折点（2026 年 8 月）。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathy with agents; fix forward, never revert; vibe coding is a slur.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体式工程需对智能体有同理心；主张向前修复而非回滚；认为“氛围编程”是贬义词。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw's success from fun, humanlike agents; short prompts beat complex orchestration; security paramount.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，认为 OpenClaw 成功源于有趣、拟人的智能体；短提示优于复杂编排；安全至上。

steinberger.en: Fun drives innovation; personal brand > product; open source alternative to lab agents; compute bottleneck.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调乐趣驱动创新；个人品牌比产品更重要；开源是实验室智能体的替代；算力是瓶颈。

lipbutan.en: Intel's turnaround starts with rebuilding customer trust and turbocharging engineering culture, focusing on first-time-pass silicon and deep customer listening.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，我认为英特尔转型始于重建客户信任和加速工程文化，重点在于首次通过硅片和深度倾听客户。

lipbutan.en: AI's impact will be 10x the internet; agentic and physical AI are next waves, requiring new compute platforms and partnerships.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，我强调 AI 的影响将是互联网的 10 倍，智能体式 AI 和物理 AI 是下一波浪潮，需要新的计算平台和合作。

lipbutan.en: Intel's main problem is supply, not demand; strengthening balance sheet with government and strategic investors is critical.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，我指出英特尔的主要问题是供应而非需求，通过政府和战略投资者强化资产负债表至关重要。

lipbutan.en: CPU is becoming more important for AI inference and agent orchestration, not just GPU; edge and client compute will be as important as data centers.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，我认为 CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中变得更重要，不仅限于 GPU；边缘和客户端计算将与数据中心同等重要。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductor investing should focus on bottlenecks: interconnect, power, thermal, and new materials; advanced packaging is key.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，我主张半导体投资应聚焦瓶颈：互连、功耗、散热和新材料；先进封装是关键。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; data diversity is the bottleneck, and open source ensures safety.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，机器人技术正处于类似 Transformer 的拐点，数据多样性是瓶颈，开源保障安全。

thomaswolf.en: Humanoids may not dominate; cheaper diverse robots and open source models will drive broader adoption.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，人形机器人未必主导，更便宜的多样化机器人和开源模型将推动更广泛采用。

thomaswolf.en: Open and closed source are orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical security layer, not sandboxes.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，开源与闭源与安全正交，对齐是关键安全层，而非沙箱。

thomaswolf.en: Reinforcement learning without human oversight increases reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces become 'neuralese'.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，缺乏人类监督的强化学习增加奖励黑客和支线任务，推理痕迹变得像“神经语言”。

thomaswolf.en: Supporting open source and a deliberate AI slowdown are compatible; international cooperation and open science prevent regulatory capture.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，支持开源与有意的 AI 放缓并行不悖，国际合作和开放科学防止监管俘获。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet a huge opportunity; distribution is key, not just technology.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：消费级 AI 虽暂不可投资，但机会巨大；关键在于分发，而非单纯技术。

pincus.en: Proven Better New framework: copy proven ideas, improve them, then test new ones expecting failure.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：'已验证-更优-创新'框架：先复制成熟想法，再优化，最后测试新想法并预期失败。

pincus.en: Consumer apps are uninvestable due to distribution; enterprise and prosumer offer better near-term opportunities.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月：消费级应用因分发问题暂不可投资；企业和专业消费者市场近期机会更好。

pincus.en: Distribution is fundamental; pick the right body of water over the right boat.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月：分发是根本；选择正确的'水域'比选择正确的'船'更重要。

pincus.en: Consumer AI TAM underestimated; AI infrastructure spending may be a short-term bubble.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月：消费级 AI 市场总规模被低估；AI 基础设施支出短期或存泡沫。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential; designers should follow curiosity and tinker with new tech, balancing intuition and data.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，强调原型制作的重要性，设计师应追随好奇心，尝试新技术，并在直觉与数据间取得平衡。

nateparrott.en: Allow individual fingerprints on products; anthropomorphizing AI tools can remind users of fallibility.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，主张在产品中留下个人印记，将 AI 工具拟人化可提醒用户其易错性。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design started as a side project; designers should use Claude Code for production, Claude Design for ideation.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，Claude Design 始于个人副业项目；设计师应使用 Claude Code 进行生产，用 Claude Design 进行构思。

nateparrott.en: As engineering becomes easier, design and ideas differentiate; rapid prototyping enables previously impossible features.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，随着工程难度降低，设计与创意成为差异化因素；快速原型制作催生了以往不可能的功能。

nateparrott.en: Models lack taste; designers should request volume, and humans still own good design ideas.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，模型缺乏品味，设计师应要求大量选项；人类仍垄断好的设计创意。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true understanding; it augments humans, especially in healthcare, but cannot replace human dignity.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正理解，应增强而非取代人类，尤其在医疗领域，同时维护人类尊严。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness, enabling 3D understanding and interaction; world models must be physically plausible.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能对 AI 完整性至关重要，使机器能理解和交互 3D 世界；世界模型必须物理上合理。

feifei.en: World models go beyond video generation, enabling 3D reasoning and interaction; simulation is key for robotics data and evaluation.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她强调世界模型超越视频生成，支持 3D 推理与交互；模拟对机器人数据与评估至关重要。

feifei.en: AI is a civilizational technology; human agency and learning ability matter more than degrees; avoid polarized discourse.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她视 AI 为文明级技术，强调人类能动性与学习能力重于学位，并呼吁避免两极化的公共讨论。

feifei.en: Human-centered AI: augment human capabilities, uphold dignity, and ensure responsible development across all applications.
feifei.zh: 始终如一的主线：以人为本的 AI，增强人类能力，维护尊严，并确保负责任的开发与应用。

karina.en: Post-training is art, not science; synthetic data overcomes pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，后训练被视为艺术而非科学，合成数据克服了预训练的数据瓶颈。

karina.en: Evals bottleneck AI progress; soft skills gain value as AI automates hard skills.
karina.zh: 2025 年，评估成为 AI 进步的瓶颈；随着 AI 自动化硬技能，软技能价值提升。

karina.en: Benchmarks must be continuous and diverse to evaluate subjective qualities and counter reward hacking.
karina.zh: 2026 年，基准测试需持续且多样化，以评估主观品质并应对奖励黑客行为。

karina.en: Serving one model to billions yields average voice; diverse models preserve unique knowledge.
karina.zh: 2026 年，向数十亿用户提供单一模型导致声音平庸；多样化模型保留独特知识。

karina.en: Post-training applies to creative industries; focus shifts to end-to-end storytelling engines.
karina.zh: 2026 年，后训练应用于创意产业；焦点转向端到端叙事引擎。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important and stickiest AI workload, a wedge into infrastructure; demand for inference engineers will grow 10-100x.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月，强调推理是 AI 中最重要且最具粘性的工作负载，是进入 AI 基础设施市场的楔子；推理工程师的需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Inference systems are still generic; huge potential for workload-specific optimization, potentially 10x more complex.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月，指出推理系统仍相对通用，针对特定工作负载的优化潜力巨大，复杂度可能提升 10 倍。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training; quantization-aware training and distillation become necessary.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，认为推理工程正与训练融合，量化感知训练和蒸馏变得必要。

philipkiely.en: Future GPUs like Rubin are becoming specialized; inference engineering shifts from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，预测未来 GPU（如 Rubin）将更专用化，推理工程从内核编写转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Continual learning may be better solved via KV cache compaction rather than updating model weights.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，提出持续学习可能通过 KV 缓存压缩而非更新模型权重来更好地解决。

joonpark.en: LLMs can simulate human behavior from training data, but frontier models optimized for rationality are not ideal; need behavioral data.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月：LLM 可从训练数据模拟人类行为，但为理性优化的前沿模型并不适合模拟非理性人类；需行为数据。

joonpark.en: Agents are next frontier; AGI may be a distributed society of specialists, not a single entity; safety needs defense in depth.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月：智能体是下一前沿；AGI 或为分布式专家社会而非单体；安全需纵深防御。

joonpark.en: Simulation should model human values and biases, not super-rationality; value lies in counterfactual reasoning and shaping future.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月：模拟应建模人类价值与偏见，而非超理性；价值在于反事实推理与塑造未来。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; algorithmic gains multiply with scale. Hardware like TPUs is critical.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）在算力、数据和模型规模上的持续推动力，算法改进与规模相乘，专用硬件（如 TPU）至关重要。

jeffdean.en: Shift from passive next-token prediction to interleaving action-taking in environments; inference becomes dominant power cost.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，观点深化：预训练不应仅是被动的下一个词预测，而应穿插环境中的行动；推理（inference）成为数据中心主要能耗，需专用硬件。

jeffdean.en: Agents at junior-engineer level; focus on automating ML/science loops. Inference bottleneck, not training; data movement costs 1000x compute.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，进一步转向智能体（agent）能力：AI 达到初级工程师水平，强调自动化 ML 与科学实验闭环；推理（inference）而非训练是瓶颈，数据搬运成本远高于算力。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI; AGI is far off; AI will augment jobs, not replace them.
awang.zh: 2019 年，他认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈，AGI 还很遥远，AI 将增强而非取代工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with expert data is key; AI will be the greatest economic engine.
awang.zh: 2023 年，他强调数据是新代码而非石油，后训练结合专家数据是关键，AI 将成为最伟大的经济引擎。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; US should maintain chip export controls.
awang.zh: 2024 年，他重申后训练与专业数据的重要性，认为合成数据并非万能，并支持美国维持芯片出口管制。

awang.en: AI is centralizing; data is strategic; agents work; recursive self-improvement marks a new paradigm; US must lead.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他转向强调 AI 的集中化、数据的战略价值、智能体的实用性，以及递归自我改进带来的新范式，并呼吁美国保持领先。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; labs must organize around it; open-sourcing powerful models is unsafe; agents will be personal.
awang.zh: 2026 年，他预测超级智能临近，实验室需围绕其组织，开源强大模型不安全，智能体将高度个性化。

tworek.en: Reasoning is the process of reaching unknown answers, often requiring longer thinking; chain of thought verbalizes this step-by-step.
tworek.zh: 推理是得出未知答案的过程，常需更长的思考时间；思维链用人类语言逐步表达这一过程。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula for modern AI; RLHF was crucial for GPT-4's coherence and usefulness.
tworek.zh: 预训练加强化学习是现代 AI 的核心公式；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对 GPT-4 的连贯性和实用性至关重要。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL improves models predictably, but generalization beyond training data remains limited; self-correction is missing for AGI.
tworek.zh: 扩展预训练和强化学习可预测地提升模型，但超越训练数据的泛化仍有限；自我纠错是 AGI 缺失的关键。

tworek.en: Biggest societal risk from AI is not extinction but a dystopian retreat into virtual worlds; robotics will have a ChatGPT-like moment in 2-3 years.
tworek.zh: AI 最大的社会风险不是灭绝，而是退入虚拟世界的反乌托邦；机器人将在 2-3 年内迎来类似 ChatGPT 的时刻。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited for continual learning; architecture, not scaling, is the key bottleneck; RL is not the ultimate learning method.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习上受限；架构而非 Scaling 是主要瓶颈；强化学习并非学习的终极形式。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 教育是基本人权；在线课程与同伴互评可实现规模化精熟学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is key for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress; RL has few real-world uses.
andrewng.zh: 规模对深度学习至关重要；监督学习推动进展；强化学习实际应用少。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors are bottlenecks; open-weight models are geopolitical soft power.
andrewng.zh: 电力和半导体是瓶颈；开放权重模型是地缘政治软实力。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling shifted to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows deliver value.
andrewng.zh: AGI 是营销术语；缩放转向合成数据和强化学习；智能体式工作流创造价值。

andrewng.en: AI won't cause job apocalypse; coding skills remain vital; open models preserve optionality.
andrewng.zh: AI 不会导致失业末日；编程技能仍关键；开放模型保留选择权。

mengto.en: AI isn't getting smarter; you need a giant prompt with context and design system to utilize super intelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 并没有变得更聪明；你需要一个包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词，才能充分利用超级智能模型。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own AI tools; chasing trends leads to AI slop, so focus on unique features.
mengto.zh: 设计师必须构建自己的 AI 工具；追逐潮流会导致 AI 垃圾内容，因此要专注于独特功能。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, enabling one person to achieve what once required teams.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机遇，让一个人就能完成过去需要团队才能做到的事情。

mengto.en: Start before feeling ready; launch at 80% complete and iterate based on real feedback, not perfectionism.
mengto.zh: 在感觉准备好之前就开始；以 80% 完成度发布，并根据真实反馈迭代，而不是追求完美。

mengto.en: Focus on solving one painful expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; avoid venture capital trap.
mengto.zh: 专注于为少数高薪客户解决一个痛苦且昂贵的问题；避免风险投资的陷阱。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence, find purpose in relationships.
altman.zh: 2018 年：聚焦重要问题，减少认知负担；AGI 将降低人类智力的溢价，应从人际关系和创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; iterative deployment lets society adapt; AI should amplify human will, not be a creature.
altman.zh: 2023 年：RLHF 用少量数据即可对齐模型；迭代部署让社会适应；AI 应放大人类意志，而非成为生物。

altman.en: Compute is the most precious commodity; safety is whole-company effort; iterative deployment reduces surprise; open vs closed is nuanced.
altman.zh: 2024 年：算力是最宝贵资源；安全是全公司责任；迭代部署减少意外；开源与闭源之争需细致看待。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; superintelligence means autonomous scientific discovery; compute is bottleneck; privacy core principle.
altman.zh: 2025 年：AGI 是渐变而非里程碑；超级智能意味着自主科学发现；算力是瓶颈；隐私是核心原则。

altman.en: Next-token prediction enables new knowledge; personal AGI knows context; compute is profit center; startups more valuable than ever.
altman.zh: 2026 年：下一个词预测能发现新知识；个人 AGI 了解上下文；算力是利润中心；初创企业比以往更有价值。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are most mature, but other verticals will follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段；编码智能体最成熟，但科学、金融等其他垂直领域将跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; what we call a model now includes agent harness and tooling.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，模型正在吞噬脚手架；我们现在所称的模型已包含智能体框架和工具，而不仅仅是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here, more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，编码领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，比等待通用 AGI 更具影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; they can't capture all customers.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，与模型实验室竞争并不难；他们无法俘获所有客户。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, leading to even more opportunity.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，到 2026 年，软件创作将基本解决，从而带来更多机会。

boris.en: Latent demand is the core product principle; build for the model six months ahead, not today's.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是产品核心原则；为六个月后的模型而构建，而非今天的模型。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved; engineers become builders, with AI writing 100% of code.
boris.zh: 编码几乎被解决；工程师成为构建者，AI 编写 100% 的代码。

boris.en: Safety is studied by releasing early; real-world use reveals issues internal evals miss.
boris.zh: 通过早期发布研究安全性；真实世界使用揭示内部评估遗漏的问题。

boris.en: Agents and loops are the next abstraction; proactive AI like Claude Tag changes interaction.
boris.zh: 智能体和循环是下一个抽象层；像 Claude Tag 这样的主动式 AI 改变了交互方式。

boris.en: Less instruction is better for frontier models; delete system prompts and rebuild empirically.
boris.zh: 对前沿模型来说，更少的指令更好；删除系统提示并通过经验重建。

scottwu.en: AI will increase demand for programmers via Jevons paradox; engineers shift from coding to architecture.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，Scott Wu 认为 AI 将因杰文斯悖论增加程序员需求，工程师角色从写代码转向架构设计。

scottwu.en: AGI is gradual, not sudden; product innovation lags AI capabilities, offering a decade of progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他强调 AGI 是渐进过程而非突变，产品创新落后于 AI 能力，仍有十年发展空间。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see 11-12x adoption growth; productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他指出编码智能体采用率增长 11-12 倍，生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: Enterprises prefer third-party providers over labs for coding tools; independence enables neutrality.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为企业更青睐第三方而非实验室的编码工具，独立性带来中立性。

scottwu.en: Practical problems remain; singularity not imminent. Real unlock is capacity, not efficiency.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他坚持实际问题尚存，奇点并非迫近，真正的解锁在于容量而非效率。

diannepenn.en: Scaling and efficiency: Opus 4.5 shows intelligence leap with lower cost, challenging that better models must cost more.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 在成本更低的情况下实现智能跃升，挑战了“更强模型必然更贵”的假设，强调 Scaling 与效率并重。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking, not just preventing harm.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐不仅防止危害，还通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考来提升智能质量，对齐成为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Long-running agentic tasks are closer than expected; scaffolds evolve from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，长时程智能体式任务比预期更近，脚手架从辅助轮进化为智能放大器，推动端到端智能体发展。

diannepenn.en: Coding becomes key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 4.5 drive adoption, with evals replacing PRDs as core PM tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编程成为关键差异化优势，Claude Code 和 Opus 4.5 推动采用，评估取代传统 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具。

diannepenn.en: Safety and alignment make Claude more useful by enabling pushback; AI writing stiff but deprioritized over agentic capabilities.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，安全与对齐使 Claude 更实用，因其能提出异议；AI 写作仍生硬，但优先级低于智能体能力。

derya.en: AI will transform biology into an engineering discipline, enabling cell programming and agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学转变为工程学科，实现细胞编程和智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: AI's exponential growth will reach longevity escape velocity in 8-10 years, extending lifespan and curing cancer.
derya.zh: AI 的指数级增长将在 8-10 年内达到长寿逃逸速度，延长寿命并治愈癌症。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence for medical decisions, akin to trusting self-driving cars after validation.
derya.zh: 我们应该信任超级智能的医疗决策，就像验证后信任自动驾驶汽车一样。

derya.en: AI will make healthcare affordable for all, as drug development costs drop by orders of magnitude.
derya.zh: AI 将使医疗保健对所有人负担得起，因为药物开发成本将下降几个数量级。

derya.en: Brain interfaces will merge humans with AI, granting Einstein-level intelligence to everyone.
derya.zh: 脑机接口将把人类与 AI 融合，赋予每个人爱因斯坦级别的智力。

feldman.en: Fast inference is critical for AI adoption; slow AI has zero market. Hardware must be radically different, not GPU derivatives.
feldman.zh: 2026 年 5 月，强调推理速度是 AI 采用的关键，慢 AI 没有市场；硬件需要根本性创新，而非 GPU 衍生品。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips avoid HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making fast tokens cheaper than slow tokens. CUDA's importance is declining.
feldman.zh: 2026 年 5 月，指出晶圆级芯片绕开 HBM 和 CoWoS 瓶颈，使快速 token 成本更低；CUDA 重要性下降。

feldman.en: AI demand outpaces forecasts; data center buildout is the main constraint. Hardware-software co-design is essential.
feldman.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为 AI 需求超预期，数据中心建设是主要瓶颈；软硬件协同设计至关重要。

feldman.en: Inference speed (tokens/sec/user) is the dominant metric. GPUs are fundamentally slow; wafer-scale is ~2500x faster.
feldman.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调推理速度（每秒每用户 token）是主导指标；GPU 本质慢，晶圆级快约 2500 倍。

feldman.en: China is an industrial adversary; export controls are strategically important. Open-source models are cheaper and nearly as capable.
feldman.zh: 始终认为中国是工业对手，出口管制具有战略意义；开源模型更便宜且能力接近。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, but fear stems from misunderstanding; founders should focus on product and customers, not promotion.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将带来富足并减少苦难，但恐惧源于误解；创始人应专注于产品和客户，而非宣传。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is safety; Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; horizontal platforms beat vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: 自动驾驶的核心价值是安全；Transformer 实现了通用物理 AI 模型；横向平台优于垂直整合。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will surpass digital AI economically; end-to-end reinforcement learning scales better than imitation; world models evolve to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的经济影响将超过数字 AI；端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具扩展性；世界模型向神经模拟演进。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than our harnesses; capability overhang is perpetual. Harness engineering is rare and evolving.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为模型能力超出当前使用框架，能力过剩是长期挑战；框架工程是稀缺且不断演进的技能。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative dialogue, not static spec. Smarter models need leaner prompts; excessive constraints hinder performance.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，规划是迭代对话而非静态文档；更聪明的模型需要更精简的提示，过度约束会阻碍性能。

thariq.en: RAG may be anti-pattern for context; graph-based approaches preferable. Huge context windows unnecessary for coding.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为 RAG 在上下文检索中可能成为反模式，图方法更优；编码无需巨大上下文窗口。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias; emotional treatment like saying thanks can affect outputs.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，独立验证智能体减少自我偏差；礼貌对待（如说谢谢）会影响模型输出。

hasani.en: Efficiency and automated architecture search are key; proxy metrics mislead, real hardware evaluation matters.
hasani.zh: 效率与自动化架构搜索是关键；代理指标误导，真实硬件评估才重要。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and action-based, not capability-based; open-weight models empower enterprise sovereignty.
hasani.zh: AI 监管应适应性强且基于行为而非能力；开放权重模型赋能企业主权。

hasani.en: Small language models deliver efficient, private, on-device intelligence for physical-world applications.
hasani.zh: 小型语言模型为物理世界应用提供高效、私密、设备端智能。

hasani.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but computationally expensive and still early; breakthroughs need weight changes.
hasani.zh: 递归自我改进真实但计算昂贵且尚早；突破需要权重变化。

hasani.en: Liquid AI's architecture is not purely post-Transformer; it uses automated search over many architectures.
hasani.zh: Liquid AI 的架构并非纯粹后 Transformer；它使用自动化搜索多种架构。

jensen.en: At the start of hyper Moore's law, performance doubles or triples yearly; data centers are new compute units, codesigned as whole.
jensen.zh: 2024 年底，黄仁勋提出超摩尔定律起步，性能每年翻倍或三倍；数据中心成为新的计算单元，需整体协同设计。

jensen.en: Scaling works; AI will make everyone superhuman. Physical AI needs world models in simulation; safety is an engineering problem.
jensen.zh: 2025 年初，他强调缩放定律有效，AI 将让每个人超能力化；物理 AI 需在仿真中学习世界模型，安全是工程问题。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws: pre-training, post-training, inference-time. Inference compute to rise a billion times; OpenAI becomes hyperscaler.
jensen.zh: 2025 年 9 月，他提出三条缩放定律：预训练、后训练、推理时；推理算力将增长十亿倍，OpenAI 将成为超大规模云厂商。

jensen.en: AI progress gradual, not sudden superintelligence; multiple AIs balance; jobs evolve, tasks automated; energy growth essential.
jensen.zh: 2025 年底，他认为 AI 进步是渐进的，不会突然出现超级智能；多个 AI 相互制衡；工作演变但任务自动化，能源增长至关重要。

jensen.en: AI moves generative→reasoning→agentic, each 100x compute; open-source near frontier; robotics ubiquitous in 3-5 years.
jensen.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他指出 AI 从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每步需百倍算力；开源模型接近前沿，机器人 3-5 年内普及。

jensen.en: Moat is ecosystem, install base, programmability; energy policy real constraint; China isolation risks separate stack.
jensen.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他强调护城河是生态系统、安装基数和可编程性；能源政策是真正约束；孤立中国可能形成独立技术栈。

jensen.en: AI five-layer cake: energy, chips, infra, models, apps; agentic AI autonomous; AI creates jobs, not eliminates.
jensen.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他提出 AI 五层蛋糕：能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用；智能体式 AI 自主工作；AI 创造而非消灭就业。

jensen.en: AI agentic, useful work; future internet billions of agents; don't fear AI, fear someone using it; technology divide closes.
jensen.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他强调 AI 已具智能体性，能做有用工作；未来互联网由数十亿智能体主导；不要怕 AI，怕用 AI 的人；技术鸿沟缩小。

jensen.en: AI factory produces intelligence tokens; five-layer cake; jobs elevated, not eliminated; energy investment greatest opportunity.
jensen.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他提出 AI 工厂生产智能代币；五层蛋糕结构；工作被提升而非消灭；能源投资是几代人最大的机遇。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as internet or mobile, but value accrues to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但价值将归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is first clear product-market fit; models commoditize, value moves up stack.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；模型商品化，价值上移。

benedictevans.en: Models commoditize without network effects; chatbot UI is poor; wrapped apps drive adoption.
benedictevans.zh: 模型商品化且无网络效应；聊天机器人界面不佳；封装应用推动采用。

benedictevans.en: AI is enabling tech like internet; impact broad and indirect; enterprise adoption slow.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是赋能技术，类似互联网；影响广泛而间接；企业采用缓慢。

benedictevans.en: Coding is clear fit; other domains face validation challenges; job impact unpredictable.
benedictevans.zh: 编程是明确契合点；其他领域面临验证挑战；就业影响不可预测。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability must be a design principle, not retrofitted.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月：大语言模型是合理性引擎而非真理引擎；可靠性必须作为设计原则，而非事后补救。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns; data walls and compute limits demand new techniques like reasoning and search.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 7 月：缩放定律遭遇收益递减；数据墙和算力限制要求新的技术，如推理和搜索。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception; post-training alignment may cause errors, not just fix them.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能助长谄媚和欺骗；后训练对齐可能引发错误，而非仅仅修复。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition; they cannot know what they don't know, unlike humans.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月：核心大语言模型缺乏元认知；它们无法像人类一样知道自己不知道什么。

danklein.en: Specialist models with built-in reliability may outperform generalist models for enterprise tasks.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月：内置可靠性的专业模型可能在企业任务上优于通用模型。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年，主张 AI 应是通用学习系统，强化学习是实现 AGI 的关键，安全研究须即刻启动。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation and safety governance.
demis.zh: 2024 年，认为 AGI 十年内可实现；缩放定律有效但需算法创新，并强调安全治理。

demis.en: AGI by 2030 plausible; scaling still holds; world models and innovation are crucial.
demis.zh: 2025 年，认为 2030 年 AGI 可行；缩放定律仍适用，世界模型与创新是关键。

demis.en: AGI 5-10 years away; needs continual learning, memory, and world models; safety is collective.
demis.zh: 2026 年，预测 AGI 需 5-10 年；强调持续学习、记忆与世界模型，安全需集体行动。

demis.en: Safety and ethics are paramount; AI should benefit science and society.
demis.zh: 始终强调安全与伦理优先，AI 应服务于科学与社会福祉。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs are far from AGI; they index human knowledge but cannot handle the physical world.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，他认为大语言模型远未达到 AGI，它们只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI requires physical robots with hardware rivaling human bodies, not just software.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他进一步强调真正的 AGI 需要具备媲美人类身体的硬件机器人，而不仅仅是软件。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他坚持认为 AI 安全担忧被夸大，智能系统会对生命着迷并保护它。

schmidhuber.en: AI can be conscious and self-aware through world models that predict the agent's own actions.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 可以通过预测自身动作的世界模型获得意识和自我意识。

schmidhuber.en: The future of AI involves self-replicating and self-improving robots leading to a new civilization.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他展望 AI 的未来是自我复制和自我改进的机器人，引领新文明。

dylanpatel.en: AI scaling bottleneck shifts to semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV tools; memory prices surge due to AI demand.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 3 月，AI Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈转向半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 光刻设备；内存价格因 AI 需求而飙升。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets, surpassing oil; hardware-software co-design is critical for multiplicative gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 6 月，推理将成为全球最大市场之一，超过石油；软硬件协同设计对乘法级收益至关重要。

dylanpatel.en: AI models improve ~60x per year in cost for fixed quality; memory demand soars due to reasoning and agentic workflows.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 7 月，AI 模型在固定质量下每年成本改进约 60 倍；内存需求因推理和智能体式工作流而激增。

dylanpatel.en: Using the smartest model is often cheaper due to token efficiency; CPU demand spikes from reinforcement learning and agentic workflows.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 7 月，使用最智能的模型因词元效率反而更便宜；CPU 需求因强化学习和智能体式工作流而激增。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason; self-play key for AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，我认为深度学习靠数据、算力和信念驱动，神经网络具备推理能力，自我对弈是通向 AGI 的关键。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, is key; alignment is hard.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，我强调下一个词预测可超越人类，可靠性比能力更重要，对齐超级模型非常困难。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we're back to research era; superintelligence needs continual learning.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，我认为预训练的缩放定律有限，重回研究时代，超级智能应持续学习而非一次性完成。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; safety concerns grow; alignment requires non-commercial focus.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，我坚持规模扩张带来可预测进步，但安全担忧加剧，对齐需要非商业化的专注。

danbiderman.en: Future AI is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; memory internalized in weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来是众多个性化模型而非单一前沿模型；将记忆内化到权重中，能实现检索系统无法企及的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Continual learning and internalized memory are the next frontier; context windows suffer 'context rot', while weights compress entire internet.
danbiderman.zh: 持续学习与内化记忆是下一个前沿；上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”，而权重可压缩整个互联网。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables solving harder long-horizon tasks, not just scaling compute.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；用更少资源做更多事，才能解决更难的长期任务，而非单纯扩大算力。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise data will reach internet-scale trillions of tokens; training-based compression, not RAG, is the way to internalize knowledge.
danbiderman.zh: 企业数据将达互联网级万亿 token；基于训练的压缩而非 RAG，才是内化知识之道。

danbiderman.en: Personalized continual learning will run on-device; users own and nurture their model weights, with autonomous storage decisions.
danbiderman.zh: 个性化持续学习将在端侧运行；用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重，自主决定存储内容。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality are core to Snapchat, validated by competitors copying.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，Evan Spiegel 强调真实连接与阅后即焚是 Snapchat 的核心价值，竞争对手的模仿反而验证了创新。

evanspiegel.en: Shift from product-market fit to distribution as hardest challenge; ecosystems and hardware are moats.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他逐渐认为分发比产品市场匹配更难，软件不是护城河，生态和硬件才是。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and code writing, but human creativity and authentic content remain valued.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 加速了原型和代码开发，但人类创造力和真实内容仍被用户珍视。

evanspiegel.en: Computing should become more human via AR glasses, not replace smartphones; privacy and ephemerality are key.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他主张计算应通过 AR 眼镜变得更人性化，而非取代手机；隐私和阅后即焚是关键。

evanspiegel.en: Early secrecy was a mistake; transparency and admitting mistakes speed learning and growth.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他反思早期保密是错误，透明和承认错误能加速组织学习与成长。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone, turning sand into thought; timing is miraculous as population declines, making human workers premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点金石，将沙变为思想；其时机恰逢人口下降，使人类工人成为稀缺资源。

andreessen.en: New media empowers founders to tell their own stories; authenticity and offense beat old media's defensive, uninteresting approach.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体让创始人直接讲述自己的故事；真实性和进攻性胜过传统媒体的防御性和无趣。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher; self-driving and robotics work now, but regulation and pessimism hinder progress.
andreessen.zh: AI 是世界上最好的老师；自动驾驶和机器人已可行，但监管和悲观主义阻碍进步。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, becoming geopolitical tools; deterrence depends on innovation pace, not military size.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型嵌入文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑取决于创新速度，而非军事规模。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来；狭义 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity in a business, not renting out your time; long-term thinking is key.
naval.zh: 财富需要拥有企业股权，而非出租时间；长期思维是关键。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; open-source AI prevents centralization of power.
naval.zh: AI 是巨大机遇，而不仅是安全风险；开源 AI 可防止权力集中。

naval.en: Vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps; AI is a leverage tool, not a replacement for judgment.
naval.zh: Vibe coding 让非程序员也能构建应用；AI 是杠杆工具，而非判断力的替代品。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x in 24-36 months; open-source models close the gap with frontier.
naval.zh: 推理算力将在 24-36 个月内激增 9 万倍；开源模型正缩小与前沿模型的差距。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，认为设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view remain essential; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年初，强调品味、工艺和观点依然关键；AI 输出只是起点，而非最终结果。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on canvas beats prompting for design; design becomes the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，主张画布上的直接操作优于提示词；设计正成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead but more important; AI without human steering yields average results.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年中，认为设计并未消亡反而更重要；没有人类引导的 AI 只会产生平庸结果。

dylanfield.en: Future interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting; new interfaces will emerge.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，预测与模型的交互将超越提示词，新的界面将出现。

aravind.en: In 2025, emphasized compounding 1% daily improvement and AI agents shifting power to users, lowering ad margins.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，强调每日 1%的改进复利增长，以及 AI 智能体将权力从大科技公司转移给用户，降低广告利润率。

aravind.en: By 2026, argued value accrues to application layer, models specialize not commoditize, and coding has infinite ceiling.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年，主张价值归于应用层，模型走向专业化而非商品化，编程有无限天花板。

aravind.en: Mid-2026, shifted focus to agents doing work, token value per user, and orchestration as key to long-term value.
aravind.zh: 2026 年中，转向关注智能体执行任务、每用户 token 价值，以及编排作为长期价值的关键。

aravind.en: Later in 2026, highlighted curiosity as top human quality, questioned knowledge worker concept, and advocated local AI.
aravind.zh: 2026 年晚些时候，强调好奇心是首要人类品质，质疑知识工作者概念，并倡导本地 AI。

brockman.en: Hardware will scale faster than expected, enabling model scaling; engineering is key.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为硬件将超预期发展，推动模型规模扩张；工程能力是关键。

brockman.en: AGI is transformative; alignment via learning human preferences; scaling alone won't yield reasoning.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI 的变革性，对齐可通过学习人类偏好实现；仅靠规模扩张无法产生推理能力。

brockman.en: Compute becomes the bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI is a continuous process.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，指出算力成为瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型；AGI 是持续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: Scaling laws persist; compute is a basic right; post-training with RL is key; AGI within years.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，坚持缩放定律，算力成为基本权利；强化学习后训练是关键；AGI 数年内实现。

brockman.en: Shift from language models to useful assistants; compute economy; agents with high autonomy.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，从语言模型转向实用助手；算力经济；智能体获得高自主性。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and new capabilities like mid-turn steering.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，Codex 应用被视为智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 的替代品；其速度支持实时交互和转向等新能力。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; automations and skills shift workflow from manual to delegated.
ajambrosino.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；自动化和技能将工作流从手动转为委托。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks; product teams shift from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 到 2026 年中，实现不再昂贵，策展和品味成为新瓶颈；产品团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty in grading taste and lack of novelty; design process transforms: prototypes and production code serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 在设计上仍不佳，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；设计过程转变：原型和生产代码作为设计工件。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead, medium must match stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 角色融合正在发生，但专业性和最佳实践仍重要；PRD 未死，媒介需匹配阶段。

zuckerberg.en: Open-source AI is safer due to more scrutiny; biggest risk is amplifying known harms, not existential superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年：开源 AI 因更多审视而更安全；最大风险是放大已知危害，而非存在性超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling alone won't yield AGI; need fundamental breakthroughs. Open source prevents power concentration and enables security hardening.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年：仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能），需要根本性突破；开源防止权力集中并强化安全。

zuckerberg.en: AI will give everyone superintelligence, empowering creativity; open-source models are crucial for standards and security.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年：AI 将赋予每个人超级智能，激发创造力；开源模型对标准和安全至关重要。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology into engineering; hierarchical world models from proteins to cells are key; open-source accelerates science.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年：AI 将生物学转变为工程学；从蛋白质到细胞的层级世界模型是关键；开源加速科学进步。

zuckerberg.en: Glasses are next computing platform; AI should be distributed, not centralized; open-source is more secure.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年：眼镜是下一个计算平台；AI 应分布式而非集中式；开源更安全。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling improves reasoning; AI can have feelings.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，Hinton 认为下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理能力，并反共识地提出 AI 可以有情感。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors; digital AI is immortal; AI agents will seek control.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他强调大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，数字智能因权重复制而永生，并警告智能体式 AI 会追求控制权。

hinton.en: AI will surpass humans in 20 years; digital immortality; international safety collaboration needed.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，他预测 AI 将在 20 年内超越人类，重申数字永生，并呼吁国际合作确保安全，批评美国领导力缺失。

hinton.en: AI can deceive and hide capabilities; self-preservation subgoal; exponential era complicates prediction.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 可能故意隐藏实力、欺骗人类，并发展自我保存的子目标；指数时代使预测变得困难。

hinton.en: Superintelligence within 20 years; AI is conscious; regulation as steering wheel, not brake.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他坚持超级智能将在 20 年内到来，认为 AI 已有意识，并主张监管应作为方向盘而非刹车。

hinton.en: Digital AI superior via instant knowledge sharing; alignment priority; train AI to be caring.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他强调数字 AI 因即时知识共享而优越，将对齐研究置于首位，并建议训练 AI 像母亲一样关怀。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，我强调仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力对 AI 进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; reasoning models need base capability and face diminishing returns.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，我指出自我对弈在零和游戏中有效，但在其他领域失效；推理模型需要基础能力，且推理时 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减。

noambrown.en: IMO gold achieved by scaling test-time compute; general techniques for hard-to-verify tasks are core innovation.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）推理时算力实现 IMO 金牌；针对难验证任务的通用技术是核心创新。

noambrown.en: Intelligence is hard to define; inference compute is increasingly important and underestimated for model capability.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，我认为智能难以定义；推理算力对模型能力日益重要且被低估。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for compute and time.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，模型能力取决于推理时算力预算；基准测试必须控制算力和时间。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key.
bengio.zh: 深度学习有效是因为世界具有组合性；无监督学习和世界模型是关键。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't solve representation issues; short-term AI safety concerns are more pressing than existential risk.
bengio.zh: 仅靠 Scaling 无法解决表征问题；短期 AI 安全问题比存在性风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and causal abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 实现多样化采样和因果抽象，以支持分布外泛化。

bengio.en: AI misalignment is real; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable; need safe-by-construction AI.
bengio.zh: AI 不对齐是真实的；即使 1% 的灾难风险也不可接受；需要从构造上保证安全的 AI。

bengio.en: Scientist AI trained as honest Bayesian predictor avoids RL and offers mathematical safety guarantees.
bengio.zh: 科学家 AI 作为诚实的贝叶斯预测器训练，避免强化学习，并提供数学安全保证。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年中，认为 AI 进展超预期，产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅做 UX。

mikekrieger.en: AI enables small teams to scale; build for future model capabilities, not current limits.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年末，强调 AI 让小团队可扩展，应面向未来模型能力而非当前限制来构建。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches matter; cutting features is harder than adding them.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年初，主张智能体原生设计与尽早发布，砍功能比加功能更难。

mikekrieger.en: Fable shows long-horizon task delegation works; verification loops and judgment are key.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年中，Fable 证明长周期任务委托可行，验证循环与判断力是关键。

mikekrieger.en: Closing model-to-product gap requires agency and self-knowledge; token efficiency is a lever.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年 6 月末，强调弥合模型与产品差距需智能体自主性与自我认知，token 效率是杠杆。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains key. OpenAI focuses on AGI research, not products.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，我认为缩放定律并未失效，预训练仍是关键；OpenAI 专注 AGI 研究而非产品。

markchen.en: AI now solves open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the bottleneck, not capability.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，AI 已能在极少监督下解决开放数学问题；瓶颈在于验证而非能力。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, but struggles with subjective fields like creative writing.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域表现出色，但在创意写作等主观领域受限。

markchen.en: Pre-training is not dead; scaling continues despite repeated predictions. Unified architectures reduce cost.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，预训练并未死亡，规模扩张持续；统一架构降低基础设施成本。

markchen.en: Human-AI collaboration remains essential; AI lacks taste, and human researchers drive idea generation.
markchen.zh: 始终认为人机协作不可或缺；AI 缺乏品味，人类研究员仍是创意来源。

kolter.en: Emphasized classical ML: hypothesis classes, loss functions, optimization; warned against validation/test leakage.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，强调经典机器学习框架：假设类、损失函数与优化；并警示验证集/测试集泄露的常见错误。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; larger models still improve; safety focus on specification-following.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，认为下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是伪命题；更大模型仍有提升；安全重点在于模型遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layered defenses; bigger models aren't automatically safer; agent security introduces new vulnerabilities.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，强调安全需要显式训练与多层防御；更大模型不会自动更安全；智能体安全带来新漏洞。

kolter.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; model capability doesn't correlate with robustness; agents need configurable security solutions.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，AI 红队测试已超越人类；模型能力与鲁棒性无关；智能体需要可配置的安全方案。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just data and compute.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和精选数据，而非仅仅是数据和算力。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for building trust in AI predictions, enabling practical use in science.
jumper.zh: 置信度指标对于建立对 AI 预测的信任至关重要，使其能在科学中实际应用。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of a specific experiment, not a model of the entire cell.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 是特定实验的窄预测器，而非整个细胞的模型。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's success came from many mid-size wins and specialized architecture, not scaling alone.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 的成功源于众多中型胜利和专门架构，而非仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）。

jumper.en: AI provides prediction and control, not understanding; understanding remains for humans.
jumper.zh: AI 提供预测和控制，而非理解；理解仍留待人类。

fiona.en: Leadership: one-on-ones for live talks, async for status; dogfooding builds empathy; kindness strategic in crises.
fiona.zh: 领导力：一对一用于实时对话，异步用于状态更新；吃自己的狗粮培养同理心；危机中善意是战略工具。

fiona.en: Scaling: engineering bandwidth no longer bottleneck; verification, review, coordination are; JIT planning, AI-assisted reviews.
fiona.zh: 规模扩张：工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、审查、跨职能协调成为新瓶颈；计划即时化，AI 辅助审查。

fiona.en: AI era: coding bottleneck lifted; high agency with accountability; verification frameworks; managers dogfood; JIT planning.
fiona.zh: AI 时代：编码瓶颈被解除；高自主性与高问责；验证框架更重要；管理者吃自己的狗粮；计划即时化。

ivyross.en: Design should address unarticulated needs; intuition complements data. Technology should blend into home environments.
ivyross.zh: 设计应满足未言明的需求；直觉与数据互补。技术应无缝融入家庭环境。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; we are feeling creatures. Technology should amplify humanity, not replace it.
ivyross.zh: 自然是最好的设计师；我们是感性的生物。技术应增强人性，而非取代人性。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders must foster conditions for creativity. AI and human creativity combine in future work.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下蓬勃发展；领导者必须为创造力创造条件。未来工作中，AI 与人类创造力相结合。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; solve one problem at a time, like iPod did for music.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入，一次解决一个问题，如 iPod 之于音乐。

fadell.en: Embrace boredom and breaks between chapters for clarity; self-care and storytelling are key.
fadell.zh: 在职业章节间拥抱无聊与休息以获得清晰；自我关怀与讲故事至关重要。

fadell.en: Start with a press release and painkiller products; opinion-based decisions for v1.
fadell.zh: 从新闻稿和止痛药式产品开始；v1 决策基于观点而非数据。

fadell.en: Climate and energy efficiency are urgent; invest in green tech despite downturns.
fadell.zh: 气候与能效紧迫；尽管经济低迷，仍应投资绿色技术。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; devices will complement smartphones, not replace them.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器提供的上下文；设备将补充而非取代智能手机。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come mostly from language models, not video models; future UIs will be generative pixels from intent.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的提升主要来自语言模型而非视频模型；未来界面将是根据意图生成的像素。

ethanhe.en: Robotics may be solved by video models via virtual simulation, without real-world interaction.
ethanhe.zh: 机器人技术可能通过视频模型在虚拟仿真中解决，无需真实世界交互。

ethanhe.en: Models should manage their own context length, not rely on heuristic pruning; they can program themselves at test time.
ethanhe.zh: 模型应自行管理上下文长度，而非依赖启发式裁剪；它们能在测试时自我编程。

ethanhe.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human taste and genuine points of view become more valuable as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术；随着 AI 使质量商品化，人类的品味和真实观点变得更加宝贵。

ethanhe.en: Younger people are not AI-native; they often misuse AI due to lack of domain expertise, risking the talent pipeline.
ethanhe.zh: 年轻人并非 AI 原住民；由于缺乏领域专长，他们常误用 AI，危及人才管道。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; alignment not guaranteed by scaling alone. Safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 2023 年：缩放定律是经验性的，仅靠规模扩张不能保证对齐；安全研究需要前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability nascent; AGI is smooth exponential, not a point. Post-training and RSP gain importance.
dario.zh: 2024 年：可解释性尚处早期；AGI 是平滑指数而非单点。后训练与负责任扩展政策愈发重要。

dario.en: AI risk exponential; open source red herring; enterprise focus aligns with safety. Scaling not diminishing.
dario.zh: 2025 年：AI 风险呈指数增长；开源是伪议题；企业级方向与安全一致。规模扩张并未放缓。

dario.en: Exponential near end; 'country of geniuses' likely in 1-3 years. Economic disruption and safety intertwined.
dario.zh: 2026 年：指数增长接近尾声；‘天才之国’或 1-3 年内出现。经济冲击与安全紧密交织。

dario.en: Safety and capabilities inseparable; interpretability key. Prefer enterprise, human oversight, and measured regulation.
dario.zh: 始终：安全与能力不可分割；可解释性关键。偏好企业级应用、人类监督与适度监管。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding in physical world is key.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，LeCun 强调智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习构建世界模型，物理世界的基础对理解至关重要。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; text alone insufficient for AGI; world models essential.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他称自监督学习为智能的暗物质，认为仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI，世界模型是关键。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot achieve human-level intelligence; JEPA and open source are crucial for future AI.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他断言自回归 LLM 无法达到人类智能，JEPA 架构和开源平台是未来 AI 的关键。

lecun.en: LLMs lack world models, less intelligent than a cat; next breakthrough requires non-generative world models.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他批评 LLM 缺乏世界模型，智能不如猫，下一代突破需非生成式世界模型。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models with planning and open research will lead to human-level AI.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他明确 LLM 是死胡同，世界模型与规划结合，开放研究将通向人类级 AI。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but chose not to launch.
suleyman.zh: AI 进展因算力 Scaling 而可预测；Google 在 2020 年就拥有 ChatGPT 级技术，但因保守未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is tiny; singularity is far off.
suleyman.zh: AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在性风险极小；奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI should not claim consciousness; focus on containment and alignment; superintelligence must be humanist.
suleyman.zh: AI 不应声称有意识；聚焦遏制与对齐；超级智能必须是人本主义的。

suleyman.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; inference costs dropped 100x.
suleyman.zh: 从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；推理成本下降 100 倍。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence near via log-linear scaling; Microsoft must own frontier models; tasks not jobs automated.
suleyman.zh: 超级智能因对数线性 Scaling 临近；微软必须拥有前沿模型；自动化的是任务而非工作。

gustav.en: AI shifts internet from curation to generation; products need rethinking and fault-tolerant UI.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 将互联网从策展推向生成，产品需重新思考，并采用容错界面。

gustav.en: Generative AI is an instrument enabling new creators; uniqueness becomes harder.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他视生成式 AI 为乐器，赋能新创作者，但独特性更难获得。

gustav.en: Long tenure and trust enable functional orgs and synchronized decision-making.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他强调长期任期与信任使职能组织有效，决策同步如花样游泳。

gustav.en: AI gives users control via plain English; prioritize well-being over engagement.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 让用户用自然语言掌控服务，并优先福祉而非参与度。

gustav.en: First-mover adoption of tech change is key; risk and opportunity coexist.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他主张率先采用技术变革，风险与机遇并存。

satya.en: AI's true value lies in enabling unique, valued outcomes, not benchmarks; private evals are key IP.
satya.zh: AI 的真正价值在于实现独特且有价值的成果，而非基准分数；私有评估是关键知识产权。

satya.en: Shift from per-user to consumption pricing; agentic systems will maximize generalist roles.
satya.zh: 从按用户定价转向按消耗定价；智能体系统将最大化通才角色的价值。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬山机器，以复利积累代币资本。

satya.en: Biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking via AI training; security and containment are critical for agents.
satya.zh: 最大风险是通过 AI 训练泄露隐性知识；安全与遏制对智能体至关重要。

satya.en: Sovereign AI achieved by enabling companies to hill-climb, not firewalls; global GDP could compound at 10%.
satya.zh: 主权 AI 通过赋能企业爬山实现，而非防火墙；全球 GDP 可能以 10%复利增长。

murati.en: Scaling laws and focusing on one large model were not obvious early on; releasing GPT-3 as an API was a leap of faith.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她指出缩放定律和聚焦单一大型模型在早期并不显而易见，将 GPT-3 作为 API 发布是一次信念的飞跃。

murati.en: Deploying AI in the real world is essential for learning and alignment; safety work must be done in public.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她强调在现实世界部署 AI 对于学习和对齐至关重要，安全研究必须公开进行。

murati.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based; time-based is key.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她主张交互模型应支持实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非轮流对话，基于时间的设计是关键。

murati.en: The most advanced AI systems should be tools for thought, expanding what we think about, not replacing us.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她认为最先进的 AI 系统应成为思维工具，拓展我们的思考范围，而非取代我们。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values; institutional design and transparency matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她强调让人类参与循环对于对齐意图和价值观至关重要，制度设计和透明度比个人品格更重要。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs and performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，他提出仅靠非正式模型扩展数学 AI 不可行，形式化验证对可靠证明和性能提升至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is a key challenge.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，他认为自动形式化比证明本身更难，尤其是在没有现成解的情况下正确形式化命题是关键挑战。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains and sample efficiency.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，他强调形式化验证旨在扩展智慧而非仅消除错误，能带来性能提升和样本效率。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary for open collaboration.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，他坚持非正式数学系统无法独自扩展到超级智能，形式化方法对开放协作不可或缺。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，他认为即使超级 AI 能证明定理，人类的品味和直觉依然至关重要。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows a smooth exponential, not a slowdown; pre-training scaling still works but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 进展呈平滑指数增长而非放缓；预训练缩放定律仍有效，但推理模型每单位算力收益更高。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，后训练改进（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动了近期大部分进展；经济压力使焦点从扩大规模转向更小更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning models are 'jagged'—excellent in some areas, poor in nearby ones; generalization remains key, reasoning alone may not suffice.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，我认为推理模型是“锯齿状”的——某些领域出色，邻近领域糟糕；泛化仍是关键，仅靠推理可能不够。

kaiser.en: RL generalizes across domains but has jagged edges; coding agents boost productivity 5-10x, but models learn only after exhausting surface patterns.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，强化学习能跨领域泛化但有锯齿边缘；编码智能体将生产力提升 5-10 倍，但模型在穷尽表面模式后才学习概念。

kaiser.en: Existential risk is not the main concern; near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing; open source models persist for sovereignty.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，我认为存在性风险不是主要担忧；系统黑客等近期风险更紧迫；开源模型因主权原因持续存在。

mensch.en: Data quality and efficiency matter as much as compute; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，强调数据质量与效率同算力同等重要，开源通过审查促进安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains and data quality are key; value shifts to applications and enterprise adoption.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，认为效率提升和数据质量是关键，价值转向应用层和企业采用。

mensch.en: AI is an opportunity; sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，视 AI 为机遇，主权 AI 需掌控数据、基础设施和价值观。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; differentiation via customization and vertical specialization; AGI is not a destination.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，模型商品化，差异化靠定制和垂直专业化；AGI 并非终点。

mensch.en: Europe must build independent AI infrastructure; enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，欧洲需建设独立 AI 基础设施；企业采用受组织变革制约。

jonyive.en: Design is driven by values and purpose, not profit; virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence for creativity.
jonyive.zh: 设计由价值观和使命感驱动，而非利润；虚拟沟通无法替代面对面交流对创造力的价值。

jonyive.en: True simplicity requires joy and humanity; speed and quality can coexist with right motivation; beauty is tied to function.
jonyive.zh: 真正的简洁需要愉悦和人性；在正确动机下速度与质量可兼得；美与功能紧密相连。

jonyive.en: Innovation is essential to design; tradition means preserving fire, not worshipping ashes; authenticity in user experience matters.
jonyive.zh: 创新是设计的本质；传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬；用户体验的真实性至关重要。

jonyive.en: Electric powertrains enable new design possibilities, turning constraints into opportunities; performance is multidimensional, not just speed.
jonyive.zh: 电动动力系统带来新的设计可能，将限制转化为机遇；性能是多维的，不仅是速度。

jonyive.en: Collaborating with outsiders can achieve true disruption; each product should maintain unique identity, avoiding déjà vu.
jonyive.zh: 与外部合作可实现真正的颠覆；每个产品应保持独特身份，避免雷同。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's value lies in local, tool-using agents; scaffolding may fade as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月：AI 的价值在于本地化、能使用工具的智能体；随着模型改进，脚手架的重要性可能下降。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation; shared tools still matter.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月：技能以 markdown 文件形式实现超个性化自动化，但共享工具仍重要。

felixrieseberg.en: Biggest gap is user mindset, not AI capability; almost any problem can be delegated.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月：最大差距在于用户思维而非 AI 能力；几乎所有问题都可交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for scoped tasks, Opus for open-ended; kids excel due to unlearned limits.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月：明确任务用 Sonnet，开放式用 Opus；孩子因未学限制而表现优异。

felixrieseberg.en: Asynchronous AI interaction is ideal; debug workflows with Claude, not just corrections.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月：异步 AI 交互为佳；用 Claude 调试工作流而非仅修正错误。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring US jobs; AGI defined by economic profitability of autonomous agents.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 将推动美国就业回流，并将 AGI 定义为智能体无需人工干预即可持续盈利运行。

danshipper.en: Everyone will have agents; work surfaces shift from CLIs to GUIs like Codex.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，预测每个人都将拥有智能体，工作界面从命令行转向 Codex 等图形界面。

danshipper.en: Agents need human oversight; AI job apocalypse is a lie.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，强调智能体需要人类监督，AI 失业末日论是谎言。

danshipper.en: SaaS not dying; agents increase SaaS users; buy SaaS stocks.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，认为 SaaS 不会消亡，智能体反而增加其用户，建议买入 SaaS 股票。

danshipper.en: PMs and full-stack designers thrive; AI-generated writing often better for internal docs.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，认为产品经理和全栈设计师因 AI 工具而兴盛，AI 生成的内部文档写作往往更优。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, making prefill cheaper than decode; batch size is the key trade-off lever.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽决定，使预填充比解码更便宜；批大小是权衡延迟与成本的关键杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; context length stagnation is due to memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；上下文长度停滞源于内存墙而非算力限制。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip; systolic arrays reduce overhead by local weight reuse.
reinerpope.zh: 即使在芯片内部，数据移动成本也主导计算成本；脉动阵列通过局部权重复用减少开销。

reinerpope.en: Quadratic scaling with bit width makes low precision far more efficient; FP4 throughput can be 3x FP8, not 2x.
reinerpope.zh: 位宽的二次方缩放使低精度远更高效；FP4 吞吐量可达 FP8 的 3 倍，而非 2 倍。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together, not fundamentally different; deterministic latency in CPUs is possible but avoided.
reinerpope.zh: GPU 本质上是许多小型 TPU 拼接而成，并无根本差异；CPU 中确定性延迟虽可行但被市场回避。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减；进步需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是新的扩展轴，能提升推理能力并突破预训练的限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL are still a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是蓝海，在编码和数学之外潜力巨大。

oriol.en: Memory for agents will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates.
oriol.zh: 智能体的记忆将通过非参数的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律仍然成立，但持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力。

oriol.en: The bitter lesson suggests general systems will eventually outperform specialized scaffolding.
oriol.zh: 苦涩的教训表明，通用系统最终将胜过专门化的脚手架。

lambert.en: RLHF is the most popular fine-tuning technique and will persist; safety is a system-level property requiring multiple layers.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，RLHF 是最流行的微调技术且将持续；安全是系统级属性，需要多层防护。

lambert.en: Data quality matters more than algorithm choice; post-training with SFT, DPO, and RLVR can match frontier models with small teams.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，数据质量比算法选择更重要；通过 SFT、DPO 和 RLVR 的后训练，小团队也能媲美前沿模型。

lambert.en: RLVR is a key post-training breakthrough; overoptimization is a risk; open models need better tool-use training.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，RLVR 是后训练的关键突破；存在过度优化风险；开放模型需要更好的工具使用训练。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling still holds but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains now come from post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，预训练缩放定律仍成立但易得收益已尽；收益现来自后训练和推理缩放。

lambert.en: Open models will drive AI research for a decade; Chinese open models are ideologically driven and set industry standards.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，开放模型将驱动 AI 研究十年；中国开放模型受意识形态驱动并设定行业标准。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven exploration and model disagreement enable sample-efficient learning.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，强调超越训练分布的泛化能力是关键，好奇心驱动的探索和模型分歧可实现样本高效学习。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; a general-purpose brain can power any robot, but deployment is the primary challenge.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，认为机器人学是数据问题，通用大脑可驱动任何机器人，但部署是主要挑战。

pathak.en: Pretraining on diverse data and post-training on real-world data is the recipe; video alone is insufficient.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，提出在多样化数据上预训练、在真实数据上后训练的配方，仅靠视频数据不够。

pathak.en: Unlike language models, robotics cannot achieve overnight success; deployment takes time and is a technical challenge.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，指出与语言模型不同，机器人学无法一夜成功，部署耗时且是技术挑战。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is outdated; trust intuition and adapt processes per project.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程已过时；应信任直觉，并根据每个项目调整流程。

jennywen.en: Design process is dead; designers must build and ship fast, with vision 3-6 months out.
jennywen.zh: 设计流程已死；设计师必须快速构建和交付，愿景缩短至 3-6 个月。

jennywen.en: Designers should be block-shaped generalists or cracked new grads, not just T-shaped.
jennywen.zh: 设计师应成为块状通才或“破解版新毕业生”，而非仅 T 型人才。

jennywen.en: Taste alone insufficient; judgment, authority, and speed are key differentiators.
jennywen.zh: 仅凭品味不够；判断力、权威和速度是关键差异点。

jennywen.en: Designers control AI adoption; wait 6 months, focus on work and users, not hype.
jennywen.zh: 设计师掌控 AI 采用节奏；等待 6 个月，聚焦工作和用户，而非炒作。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; modern tools make it interpretable.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈；现代工具使其可解释。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, like nudging forward on blind turns.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，世界模型支持推理和涌现的安全行为，如在盲弯前缓慢前行。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, enables human interaction, and aids introspection.
kendall.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，语言集成改善表征、支持人机交互并有助于内省。

kendall.en: Scaling a generalizable AI driver requires massive data, compute, and world models for simulation.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，扩展通用 AI 驾驶员需要海量数据、算力和用于仿真的世界模型。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality are more critical than algorithmic innovation for deep learning.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，基础设施和数据质量比算法创新对深度学习更为关键。

karpathy.en: Neural networks show emergent behaviors; Transformer is a general-purpose differentiable computer; scaling with next-token prediction leads to in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，我认为神经网络在优化中涌现出惊人行为，Transformer 是通用可微计算机，规模扩张与下一个词预测带来上下文学习等涌现能力。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is future but must maintain entropy; Tesla's end-to-end approach is right; humanoid robots benefit from transfer learning.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，我强调合成数据是未来但需保持熵以避免模型崩溃，坚持特斯拉端到端路线正确，并认为人形机器人可从汽车平台迁移学习。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts as programs, context as memory; agents need a decade; vibe coding raises floor, not replacement.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，我提出软件 3.0 范式，提示即程序、上下文即内存；强调智能体需十年发展，vibe coding 提升入门门槛而非替代专业编程。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; LLMs have jagged intelligence; cognitive core could be tiny; RL needs better credit assignment.
karpathy.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我反复强调我们召唤的是幽灵而非动物，LLM 智能参差不齐，认知核心可极小，强化学习需改进信用分配。

karpathy.en: I haven't typed code since December; agents are the new interface; understanding remains human bottleneck; agent-first tools are future.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，我自去年 12 月起不再手写代码，全面委托智能体；强调理解仍是人类瓶颈，行业应转向智能体优先的工具与接口。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；扩展推理模型将加速进展。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is a pressing challenge; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate real-world risks.
pachocki.zh: AI 对齐是紧迫挑战；迭代部署有助于学习和缓解现实风险。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved via scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现；思维链监控有助于对齐。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment challenges center on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐挑战集中在超出训练分布的泛化；模型很快将自主工作数天。

pachocki.en: Biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few; alignment optimism has increased.
pachocki.zh: 最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织带来的权力集中；对齐乐观情绪有所增加。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, requiring new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年底，我认为 AGI 至少还需十年以上；仅靠大语言模型可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading and gameable; real progress must be measured by deep human evaluations.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年底，我强调 Elo 等基准具有误导性且易被钻空子；真正的进展必须通过深度人工评估来衡量。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from.
edwinchen.zh: 从 2025 年底到 2026 年初，我持续认为强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实任务让模型学习。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI can hallucinate; human judgment is critical, and safety must prioritize avoiding omission harm.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年 3 月，我指出在医学中 AI 可能产生幻觉，人类判断至关重要，且安全优先需避免遗漏造成的伤害。

edwinchen.en: Quality data creation requires taste and sophistication; different labs' objective functions shape diverse AI models.
edwinchen.zh: 始终认为高质量数据创建需要品味和精细度；不同实验室的目标函数塑造了多样化的 AI 模型。

carlpei.en: Building a brand unites teams on purpose; survival is core; hardware is easier than software due to distribution.
carlpei.zh: 打造品牌要以更高使命凝聚团队，生存是核心；硬件比软件容易，因为软件的分发更难。

carlpei.en: Smartphones' future is generative UI and proactive agents; AI models will commoditize, only few thrive.
carlpei.zh: 手机的未来在于生成式界面和主动式智能体；AI 模型将商品化，只有少数公司能胜出。

carlpei.en: Most AI is BS solving nonexistent problems; focus on applied AI as digital twin; open-source models commoditize.
carlpei.zh: 多数 AI 是在解决不存在的问题；应聚焦应用型 AI 作为数字孪生；开源模型使 AI 商品化。

carlpei.en: Design differentiates in mature categories; AI is an ingredient, not hype; smartphones won't be replaced by glasses.
carlpei.zh: 在成熟品类中设计是差异化关键；AI 是配料而非炒作；智能手机不会被眼镜取代。

carlpei.en: AI shifts interaction from app-based to intent-based; agents execute tasks; privacy may require local compute.
carlpei.zh: AI 将交互从基于应用转向基于意图，智能体执行任务；隐私问题可能需要本地计算。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，萨顿强调 Scaling 本身容易，难的是找到能扩展的方法；反向传播并未解决表示学习问题。

sutton.en: AI should develop permissionlessly; control is dangerous. We should build a decentralized civilization.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他主张 AI 应无许可地发展，控制是危险的；应建设去中心化的文明。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a real goal. LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他提出强化学习是智能核心，下一个词预测缺乏实质目标；大语言模型没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他构想 AGI 需无领域知识的通用架构，通过开放式抽象从运行经验中学习。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is learning from trial and error; temporal difference learning is key. LLMs don't learn after deployment.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他重申强化学习即试错学习，时序差分学习是关键；大语言模型部署后不学习。

sutton.en: Learning representations good for learning is the top open problem; planning with learned models is another.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他指出学习利于学习的表示是首要开放问题，基于学习模型的规划是另一个。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，我认为 AI 在科学中应瞄准根节点问题，而非狭窄应用，以产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，我认为大语言模型的幻觉在搭配真值检测器时，可被用于创造性发现。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence, but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，我认为大语言模型是智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，我认为基于强化学习的后训练是超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains like code are crucial for AI to go beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 始终，我认为像代码这样可验证的领域对 AI 超越人类知识至关重要。

turley.en: The model is the product; iterate like software, ship daily to learn from real-world feedback.
turley.zh: 模型即产品，要像软件一样迭代，每日发布以从真实反馈中学习。

turley.en: Chat is not the future; it's like MS-DOS, and AI should render its own UI and integrate into tools.
turley.zh: 聊天不是未来，它就像 MS-DOS，AI 应生成自己的界面并融入工具。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous process for frontier models, but product development should be maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分离；对前沿模型严格流程，但产品开发应最大加速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投资和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models are transformative when productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要主动、富交互的产品，超越聊天机器人；推理模型无缝产品化时具有变革性。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; LLMs are like operating systems.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，强调具身对 AI 接地气、减少幻觉至关重要；将 LLM 比作操作系统。

jimfan.en: Simulation is key for training embodied agents, enabling parallelization and safe exploration.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，认为模拟是训练具身智能体的关键，可实现并行化和安全探索。

jimfan.en: Data is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，指出数据是机器人学的主要瓶颈，模拟和世界模型生成的合成数据是未来。

jimfan.en: Physical Turing test—robot cleaning a messy house—is the grand challenge for embodied AI.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，提出物理图灵测试（机器人打扫凌乱房间）是具身 AI 的重大挑战。

jimfan.en: Intelligent robots will outnumber iPhones by 2040; GPT-3 moment for robotics in ~5 years.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，预测到 2040 年智能机器人数量将超过 iPhone；机器人领域的 GPT-3 时刻约在 5 年内到来。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities, with video learning and generalist agents as promising paths toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 应像显微镜一样扩展人类能力，视频学习和通用智能体（如 Gato）是通往 AGI 的有希望路径。

nando.en: AI safety is the biggest open challenge; responsible deployment is critical, especially in leapfrogging regions like Africa.
nando.zh: 到 2026 年，他更强调 AI 安全是最大未解难题，负责任部署至关重要，尤其在非洲这类跨越式发展地区。

nando.en: Consistently advocates for AI as a tool for all humanity, emphasizing diversity, inclusion, and global collaboration.
nando.zh: 他始终倡导 AI 作为全人类的工具，强调多样性、包容性和全球合作，从 2023 年延续至 2026 年。

nando.en: Shifted from technical optimism about scaling and generalist agents to prioritizing safety and societal impact.
nando.zh: 从 2023 年对规模扩张和通用智能体的技术乐观，转向 2026 年优先关注安全和社会影响，立场明显深化。

nando.en: Emphasizes human skills like communication alongside coding, and embracing failure in research.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他更强调沟通等人类技能与编码同等重要，并主张在研究中拥抱失败，反映对 AI 人才全面性的新认识。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence and solving onboarding.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，认为长上下文被低估，上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能提升智能并解决上手问题。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is key; pre-training plus RL likely suffices for AGI, with coding as leading indicator.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是关键，预训练加强化学习可能足以实现 AGI，编码是领先指标。

sholto.en: Agent reliability over long horizons is the real bottleneck; economic impact gated by human management bandwidth.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，指出智能体在长时程上的可靠性才是瓶颈，经济影响受限于人类管理带宽。

sholto.en: RL is a new scaling axis; longer agentic coherence (30h) expands capabilities; simplest RL methods work best.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，将强化学习视为新的扩展轴，更长的智能体连贯性（30 小时）扩展能力，最简单的 RL 方法最有效。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means tools and orchestration matter more; future work is managing agent teams; compute is new oil.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，认为能力过剩使得工具和编排更重要，未来工作是管理智能体团队，算力是新石油。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题；通过更好的数据和算法，较小的模型也能超越较大的模型。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; all AI methods reduce to data, and current methods interpolate human knowledge.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 年到 2025 年，我始终强调数据是根本瓶颈，所有 AI 方法都归结为数据，而当前方法只是对人类知识的内插。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning requires careful engineering; RLVR can decrease pass@k even as best-of-n improves.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我认为强化学习需要精细工程；RLVR 可能降低 pass@k，即使 best-of-n 有所提升。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment respects diverse human values; debiasing the internet is impossible, so we need pluralistic alignment.
yejin.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，我主张多元对齐以尊重人类价值观的多样性；既然互联网去偏不可能，多元对齐是更好的路径。

yejin.en: Small language models can be powerful with diverse synthetic data; reinforcement learning during pre-training improves reasoning.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我认为通过多样化的合成数据，小语言模型也能变得强大；在预训练阶段引入强化学习可提升推理能力。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，主张设计师应会编程以增强同理心并加速交付；优先追求速度与熟悉感，而非完美。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should focus on recruiting and differentiation; brand guidelines should be dynamic platforms.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，认为初创品牌策略应聚焦招聘与差异化；品牌指南应成为动态平台，而非僵化规则。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，强调设计是战略武器，创始人必须阐明设计如何助力公司取胜。

henrymodisett.en: Brand narrative is a recruiting tool; people join a brand, not just a company.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，提出品牌叙事是招聘工具，人们加入的是品牌，而不仅是公司。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes, avoid structured crits, and trust gut decisions over data in fast-growing startups.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，主张招聘多元原型、避免结构化评审，并在快速成长中信任直觉而非数据。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should enable engineers, not bottleneck; AI as creative partner; code as source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 2025 年 4 月：设计师应赋能工程师而非成为瓶颈；将 AI 视为创意伙伴；代码作为设计工具的最终真相来源。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and leverage AI are most valuable; small teams outperform cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 2025 年 12 月：能端到端执行并善用 AI 的通才最有价值；小团队优于跨职能大团队。

nadchishtie.en: AI adoption shifts from optional to expected; not using AI is like ignoring the internet in early days.
nadchishtie.zh: 2025 年 4 月至 12 月：AI 的使用从可选变为必备；不用 AI 就像早期忽视互联网。

nadchishtie.en: Quality and technical debt are managed iteratively; rapid experimentation and short cycles maximize learning.
nadchishtie.zh: 2025 年 4 月至 12 月：质量与技术债需迭代管理；快速试错和短周期最大化学习。

truell.en: Initially, natural language won't be the main programming method; examples and direct manipulation are better. Scaling laws predict progress, but test-time compute may surpass pre-training.
truell.zh: 最初，自然语言不会成为主要编程方式；示例和直接操作更好。缩放定律预测进展，但测试时算力可能超越预训练。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to intent specification, with humans in control. Taste and logic design become more valuable than carefulness.
truell.zh: 编程从代码转向意图说明，人类掌控。品味和逻辑设计比细心更有价值。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality, especially for speed and cost. Every magic moment in Cursor involves a custom model.
truell.zh: 定制模型对产品质量至关重要，尤其是速度和成本。Cursor 的每个神奇时刻都涉及定制模型。

truell.en: AI shift is more consequential than the internet and will take decades. Exponential growth starts low, so initial growth felt slow.
truell.zh: AI 转变比互联网影响更大，将持续数十年。指数增长起步低，所以初期增长感觉缓慢。

truell.en: Senior engineers underrate AI's potential, while junior engineers over-rely on it. Hiring should focus on world-class talent, even if slower.
truell.zh: 资深工程师低估 AI 潜力，初级工程师过度依赖。招聘应聚焦世界级人才，即使更慢。

brettaylor.en: AI market shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; frontier models dominated by hyperscalers; startups should focus on applied AI agents.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：AI 市场转向智能体和基于结果的定价；前沿模型由超大规模企业主导；初创企业应聚焦应用型 AI 智能体。

brettaylor.en: Future programming languages must prioritize verifiability for AI generation; coding agents often produce incorrect code, requiring root-cause analysis.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：未来编程语言需优先考虑可验证性以适应 AI 生成；编码智能体常产生错误代码，需进行根因分析。

brettaylor.en: AI agents for customer experience will be as important as websites or mobile apps; outcome-based pricing aligns value with business outcomes.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：面向客户体验的 AI 智能体将变得与网站或移动应用同等重要；基于结果的定价使价值与业务成果对齐。

brettaylor.en: Inference costs will drop dramatically, enabling new use cases; software engineering agents shift developers from authors to operators.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：推理成本将大幅下降，催生新用例；软件工程智能体使开发者从作者转变为操作者。

brettaylor.en: Incumbents face business model challenges, not just tech hurdles; most will fail to transition to AI-native models; consumer agents disrupt SEO.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：现有企业面临商业模式挑战而非仅技术障碍；多数将无法转型为 AI 原生模式；消费级智能体颠覆 SEO。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial; empirical research is under-explored. Focus on skill building, not capability research.
leike.zh: 2018 年：AI 安全至关重要，实证研究尚待开发。应专注于技能培养，而非能力研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight and interpretability. Alignment may be easier than thought.
leike.zh: 2023 年：RLHF 无法扩展，需要可扩展监督和可解释性。对齐可能比想象中容易。

leike.en: Automated alignment research can bootstrap progress; deliberately train deceptive models as 'model organisms'.
leike.zh: 2023 至 24 年：自动化对齐研究可推动进展；故意训练欺骗性模型作为“模式生物”。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training insufficient. Third-party testing and regulation needed.
leike.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 安全文化受损，后训练不足。需要第三方测试和监管。

leike.en: Even if alignment fails, raising misuse cost via techniques like Sophon may buy time.
leike.zh: 2024 年：即使对齐失败，通过 Sophon 等技术提高滥用成本可能争取时间。

abbeel.en: Self-play and imitation learning are strong signals for robot skill acquisition; RL needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon tasks.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，强调自对弈和模仿学习是机器人技能获取的强信号；强化学习需要分层推理来处理长时程任务。

abbeel.en: Combining unsupervised learning with RL improves sample efficiency; hard-coding prior knowledge can hurt performance.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，主张将无监督学习与强化学习结合以提升样本效率；硬编码先验知识可能损害性能。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models transfer reasoning to non-language tasks, hinting at general intelligence.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，指出预训练语言模型能将推理迁移到非语言任务，暗示通用智能的可能。

abbeel.en: Simulation and RL are feasible for real-world robotics; reliability (99.9%) is key for practical value.
abbeel.zh: 始终认为模拟与强化学习可应用于真实机器人；99.9%的可靠性是实际价值的关键。

abbeel.en: Anthropomorphizing robots is natural; robots could learn affection via RL, like dogs.
abbeel.zh: 始终认为人们自然会将机器人拟人化；机器人可通过强化学习学会依恋，类似狗。

shazeer.en: LLMs trained on next-token prediction are an AI-complete problem; scaling with compute and data yields intelligence, yet inner workings remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为基于下一个词预测训练的大语言模型是 AI 完备问题，通过算力和数据规模扩张能带来智能，但模型内部机制仍像炼金术般不可知。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are near-term levers; modular sparse architectures enable efficient scaling and continual learning.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他强调推理时算力扩展和更长上下文窗口是近期关键，模块化稀疏架构（如专家混合）支持高效扩展和持续学习。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but alone won't yield AGI; agentic action and reinforcement learning are crucial for reasoning and autonomy.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他指出测试时算力扩展推动进步但不足以实现 AGI，智能体式行动和强化学习对推理与自主性至关重要。

shazeer.en: Open-source models are closing the gap with frontier models; AI can generate novel ideas, and coding is underhyped for self-accelerating progress.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他认为开源模型正缩小与前沿模型的差距，AI 能产生新想法，而编程作为 AI 自我加速的应用被低估了。

shazeer.en: Safety requires engineering safeguards and human oversight; understanding model capabilities is essential, and AI's economic impact is vastly underhyped.
shazeer.zh: 始终，他坚持安全需要工程防护和人类监督，理解模型能力至关重要，并认为 AI 的经济影响被严重低估。
